title: Go to Sleep
coreMove: Protecting sleep is not softness; it keeps your temper, appetite, focus, and honesty fit for the people who meet you tomorrow, so treat bedtime as a promise, not a leftover.

exampleSpecs.audience: people tempted to spend rest after every other demand
exampleSpecs.stakes: tomorrow's judgment may be damaged while tonight's list looks heroic
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Before work begins, sleep receives the first protected place on the evening page.

exampleSpecs.domain: a late-night departure after a Stanford sleep medicine event
exampleSpecs.audience: an exhausted organizer with a ride problem
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether she risks a drowsy drive or wakes someone who needs rest too
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: both available choices carry a cost, making this the only two-bad-options scene

exampleSpecs.domain: two coworkers talking over a late pitch deck
exampleSpecs.audience: a team member tempted to turn exhaustion into status
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the deck gets one more tired hour or a clean stop
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the lesson lands through the exchange, with Arianna Huffington's 2007 collapse doing real work in the talk

exampleSpecs.domain: a training cohort adding a late study block before a quiz
exampleSpecs.audience: a supervisor who assumes more study time will lift scores
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether extra effort helps learning or steals the sleep that stores it
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the reader expects a quiz gain, then sees the drop caused by lost sleep

exampleSpecs.domain: a late message exchange about finishing a sleep advocacy slide deck
exampleSpecs.audience: a presenter caught in the irony of overworking a rest talk
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether she keeps polishing or accepts a rougher deck and a clearer morning
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the short chat lands the lesson between lines rather than in a lecture

exampleSpecs.domain: a bedtime routine interrupted by a quick request for feedback
exampleSpecs.audience: a designer trying to protect the end of the night
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether one small reply reopens work inside a sleep routine
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A bedtime request is parked for morning without repeating the stop-restart machine.
